info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Legal Advisory Service Management API
info.description: The Legal Advisory Service Management API enables enterprises to update and manage their legal advisory requests efficiently. This endpoint allows authorized users to modify specific aspects of existing legal advisory submissions, ensuring that the most current information is reflected. Typical users include legal teams, compliance officers, and operations managers requiring timely updates. Utilize this API to streamline legal advisory operations within your organization and enhance response accuracy and efficiency.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific legal advisory resource identified by its unique identifier. Use this operation to modify attributes as per your requirements and ensure that the data is current.
